A nearby contemporary Mediterranean home contains original works of art including a Ralph Cowan portrait. A two-story Dutch Colonial houses an impressive collection of antique pieces including an 18th century epergne originally owned by the Tiffany family. Antique pieces as well as a collection of oyster plates are displayed in another residence. A tour highlight is an extensive Japanese garden complete with rock gardens and water features. The home's decor reflects the owners' travels and their love of nature.

description: With its powerful story, its energetic, toe-tapping Gospel, Rock, Country, and Rhythm and Blues score, Violet is a musical sure to rouse the spirit and touch the heart. Set in 1964 in the Deep South during the early days of the Civil Rights Movement, Violet follows the growth and enlightenment of a hopeful young woman whose face was accidentally scarred by an errant ax blade.
